---
title: "About"
---

This site publishes the latest output of four systematic strategies I run, together with their historical backtests. The Core Portfolio combines a passive core with Global Equity Rotation, Gold Trend and Bitcoin Trend.

| Strategy | Asset class | Style | Rebalance |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Global Equity Rotation](strategies/dca.qmd) | Country equity ETFs | Multi-factor long / short | Weekly |
| [Value-Growth Rotation](strategies/value_growth.qmd) | US large-cap value vs growth ETFs | Trend-following, long / short | Monthly |
| [Gold Trend](strategies/gold.qmd) | Gold | Trend-following, long / flat | Daily |
| [Bitcoin Trend](strategies/btc.qmd) | Bitcoin | Trend-following, long / flat | Daily |

Each strategy page has three tabs:

- **Latest signal:** the current position and the recent signal window from the latest production run.
- **Backtest:** the historical simulation, with growth of $1,000, drawdowns, calendar-year returns and summary statistics.
- **How it works:** a short description of the approach.

## Notes on the numbers

- **No look-ahead:** a position decided at the close of day *t* earns the return from *t* to *t + 1*.
- **Costs:** gold and bitcoin results are shown **before** transaction costs. Global Equity Rotation and Value-Growth Rotation results are **net** of trading and short-borrow costs.
- **Cash:** when the gold or bitcoin strategy is flat, its cash earns the overnight fed funds rate (rate × days held / 365).
- **Simulated results:** backtests are hypothetical and were produced with the benefit of hindsight. Live results can differ because of costs, slippage, data revisions and model changes.
